newsitem.title: UK: ICI gains as results contain no fresh shock.
newsitem.headline: ICI gains as results contain no fresh shock.

text.p: Shares in Imperical Chemical Industries Plc bounced back from recent declines on Thursday after third-quarter results met already-low analyst expectations and provided no fresh negative surprises, analysts said.
The stock was up 19p at 794-1/2 by 0749 GMT, after on Wednesday dropping to its lowest level in over two months.
"People were relieved that the result was not even worse," said Peter Blair, analyst at Salomon Brothers, "and the stock looks reasonably attractive on a valuation basis."
Added one trader: "The stock was so oversold in front of the figures it has rebounded even though the figures don't look so clever."

The chemical group posted a drop in third-quarter pre-tax, pre-exceptional profit to 131 million stg from 248 million stg a year before. Analyst expectations had been in a range between 127 million stg and 140 million.
ICI said the decline was due mainly to cyclical price pressures in industrial chemicals, polyester, titanium and chlorine, while paints continued to perform strongly.
"The results were at the low end of consensus but there was no surprise in the mix," said Blair. "Most areas are reasonably OK, it is in industrial chemicals that they have been creamed."
"But I think all the bad news is in there, this is the trough and they will pick up from here."
